reason: My customers are mostly older people with a dripping tap or a dead boiler, and they want to hear a human voice, not get a robot text from my number. I might let them run the free 14-day count out of curiosity, but I'm not handing my phone line to two guys with no customers for 99 € a month.
objection: A text or a recording in my name makes me look like a call centre, and if their system hiccups I lose the customers I already have. Who is liable then, a start-up with zero customers?
would_change_my_mind: If the free check shows I really lose five or more new jobs a month, and a colleague from my Innung tells me his customers didn't mind the SMS.
